Welcome to Your Spiritual Gifts Assessment Report

Thank you for taking the time to explore how God has uniquely equipped you to serve His Kingdom. At Discover Your Divine Design, we offer this assessment completely free because we believe every believer should have access to tools that help them understand who God created them to be. Your design is not accidental, and your gifts have purpose, meaning, and eternal significance.

Our prayer is that this report encourages you, helps clarify your calling, and helps you step confidently into the good works God has prepared for you. May what you discover here deepen your love for Christ, strengthen your service within the Body, and illuminate the path He has placed before you.

“Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.” (1 Corinthians 12:7)

{{ Next_Step_Reflection | default: "Use this space to name one place where you may want to serve, grow, or explore next." }}
My simple plan is...

What is Discover Your Divine Design

On Purpose - For Purpose

DYDD is a journey that helps you recognize how God has uniquely shaped your life for His purpose. By exploring your identity, expertise, story, desires, gifts, and niche, you begin to see the intentional way God has designed you to love, serve, and make a difference in the Body of Christ and beyond.

At the heart of this journey is the belief that you were created On Purpose - For Purpose. Your life is not random, and your design is not accidental. God has formed you with intention, redeemed your story through Christ, and prepared good works for you to walk in faithfully.

Discovering Your Divine Design is not about striving, performing, or trying to impress God. It is about responding to His grace and living more fully as the person He created you to be. As you understand your DESIGN more clearly, you can serve with greater confidence, humility, and joy.

“For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.” (Ephesians 2:10)

What were the DesignID reflection correlations

As part of the DYDD ecosystem, we have built an identity assessment designed to help you see how you reflect who God is as part of His creation and how you can use your design to love and serve. In this report, you’ve been given clues for how each gift can correlate with the four reflections. The DesignID assessment is a key aspect of the DYDD journey.

What else do we offer

We offer a variety of resources including this Spiritual Gifts Assessment, the DesignID Assessment, the Discover Your Divine Design book and workbook, online classes, and more. Check out our resource gateway.
